_about: Cancelled prints only. Gentle: the target is the print, never the operator.

entries.text: Netflix would have given this project one more season before canceling it, but you have better judgment.
The print was pulled from production before the trailer could generate any interest.
The stop button just delivered the shortest performance review in industrial history.
The project reached the rare milestone of becoming a discontinued product before becoming a product.
The cancellation has been received by the filament with the same enthusiasm as a canceled Monday meeting.
The printer has been granted a recess while the business case is reexamined.
The production crew has been sent home and the unfinished prop is not eligible for a sequel.
The stop button has finally justified its existence more convincingly than the start button did.
A venture capitalist would call this a pivot and immediately try to raise more money.
The printer has discovered a new production method called cutting your losses before they multiply.
The project has been taken off the schedule before anyone could sell tickets.
The build plate has been relieved of a contractual obligation to manufacture this particular decision.
The manufacturing equivalent of deleting an online shopping cart after seeing the shipping charge.
The only thing discontinued faster was the optimism present at the start of the print.
The cancellation notice arrived before the project could become a regular item on the household expense report.
The printer was preparing a full length feature and you wisely released it as a short.
The project got the same treatment as a restaurant reservation made during an argument.
The print was canceled before it could acquire the status of an expensive family heirloom.
The production schedule has been revised to include the radical alternative of doing nothing.
Somewhere the unextruded filament is enjoying the privilege of not being part of this story.
The project has entered the witness protection program for abandoned ambitions.
The print was withdrawn from the market before the market had the opportunity to decline it.
The stop button is the only part of this project that can claim a decisive victory.
Production has ceased following a discovery that the original enthusiasm was not a sustainable energy source.
The budget committee has voted to replace this project with an afternoon that might actually accomplish something.
The printer's dramatic pause has been extended indefinitely because the audience left.
The project is now a limited edition of zero completed units.
The cancellation has reduced the manufacturing forecast from expensive to merely embarrassing.
The printer was about to make history and instead received a sensible administrative decision.
A canceled print is a financial intervention performed by the same person who caused the financial problem.
The model has been granted the rare privilege of remaining significantly cheaper as a computer file.
The production team has been told to return its equipment and stop pitching sequels.
The printer has received a cease and desist from the last surviving sensible impulse in the room.
The cancellation department has finally demonstrated a higher rate of productivity than the manufacturing department.
The project was withdrawn before it could qualify for an extended warranty nobody would buy.
The print has been replaced on the schedule by the revolutionary invention of leaving the machine alone.
The stop command has achieved what several centuries of philosophy could not: a convincing argument for restraint.
The original business plan has been revised from producing an object to preserving what's left of the spool.
The printer has been dismissed early without having to pretend it needs the rest of the afternoon.
The project has joined the distinguished ranks of ideas that improved considerably when nobody finished them.
Good Will Hunting needed a breakthrough; this print needed someone willing to press Stop.
The janitor at MIT has one less thing to sweep up.
Matt Damon found his calling; this print has found the end of its employment contract.
The therapist's breakthrough was convincing the printer owner that quitting sometimes costs less than commitment.
Lumbergh will need that cancellation report by Saturday.
Milton would defend the stapler with his life, but even he wouldn't defend this print.
Initech has eliminated another position and somehow the machine is still the most productive employee.
Peter Gibbons has officially approved the printer's decision to stop working.
The Bobs have reviewed the project and concluded that its primary responsibility was occupying a rectangle.
Michael Scott has scheduled a mandatory meeting to celebrate the cancellation of the previous mandatory meeting.
Dwight Schrute would call this a strategic withdrawal and demand the stop button's personnel file.
The Office finally has an employee that can stop working without pretending to use the copier.
The Monty Python Ministry of Silly Walks has declined to investigate this particular step backwards.
The project has been sent to the Ministry of Things That Needn't Exist.
The director has yelled cut and, for once, the production budget actually listened.
The film has been canceled after the studio discovered that the supporting cast was literally disposable.
The Academy has withdrawn the nomination for Best Picture of Something That Wasn't Finished.
Tom Cruise does his own stunts, but even he knows when to call off a mission.
Mission Impossible has been canceled after management discovered the assignment was entirely optional.
The sequel has been canceled before the original could disappoint the test audience.
George Lucas would have waited another twenty years before releasing a special edition of this incomplete project.
The Star Wars prequels at least got authorization to finish.
Darth Vader has withdrawn funding after discovering the printer has no thermal exhaust port.
The Empire has canceled construction of another superweapon and redirected the budget toward payroll.
The Death Star's construction manager has received a surprisingly useful lesson in knowing when to quit.
The Jedi Council has determined that this is not a disturbance worth investigating.
Thanos has eliminated exactly one hundred percent of this project's remaining production schedule.
Marvel has removed the print from Phase Six after discovering nobody remembers Phase Five.
The post credits scene has been canceled because the main feature never made it to the credits.
Tony Stark has terminated the project before the cave becomes a permanent workshop.
The Hulk has demonstrated admirable restraint by pressing a button instead of remodeling the room.
Deadpool has broken the fourth wall just to inform the audience that the production has been terminated.
Batman has decided to fight crime instead of spending another evening monitoring the bed.
Alfred has finally persuaded Bruce to suspend one of his less necessary capital projects.
The Joker has canceled the scheme after discovering the city already has enough expensive problems.
The Matrix has terminated this simulation before the participants could experience the next utility bill.
Neo took the option that actually lets him go outside and do something else.
Morpheus has disconnected the project from the machine and the household has briefly regained consciousness.
John Wick has retired the project with considerably less paperwork than usual.
Keanu Reeves has walked away from this particular franchise before it needed a fourth installment.
The Wolf of Wall Street has discovered an investment strategy called stopping before the money disappears.
The board of directors has decided to stop throwing perfectly good filament after questionable filament.
The project has received a downgrade from unnecessary expenditure to expenditure avoided.
The venture capitalists have pulled the plug just before the pitch deck got to the word scalable.
The quarterly earnings report is now slightly less fictional than the original business case.
The printer has abandoned the production run before it could develop a dedicated customer support department.
The Fed has observed a rare example of voluntary quantitative tightening in a private household.
The congressional committee has canceled the hearing after realizing the printer could simply be turned off.
The project has lost its appropriation before the ribbon cutting ceremony could be scheduled.
Congress would have commissioned three studies before reaching the same decision.
The Supreme Court has declined to hear an appeal from the remaining layers.
The motion to continue has been denied with prejudice against additional filament purchases.
The jury has been dismissed after the defendant agreed not to manufacture any further evidence.
The defense rests, mostly because the machine has finally stopped making noise.
The court has enjoined further unnecessary production.
The prosecutor has withdrawn the case after determining the cost of the exhibits exceeds the value in dispute.
The insurance adjuster has been denied the opportunity to ask several deeply uncomfortable questions.
The rescue mission has been called off before anyone had to rescue the credit card.
NASA has scrubbed the launch and the only disappointed observer is the electricity company.
Mission control has decided to leave this payload on Earth, preferably in its original digital form.
The rocket has been grounded before the launch could require a congressional investigation.
The telescope has been pointed elsewhere after finding nothing of financial interest on this planet.
The experiment stopped before peer reviewers could ask why the control group needed a filament budget.
The research grant has been withdrawn after the scientists discovered the hypothesis was entirely optional.
The laboratory has paused the experiment before the results could require a larger trash container.
Pythagoras has canceled the geometry lesson before it could become a lesson in accounting.
The mathematician has stopped the proof at the point where further assumptions would require another spool.
The calculus has finally yielded a derivative that represents the rate at which good judgment returned.
Newton has declined to demonstrate the laws of motion on another unnecessary object.
Darwin has removed this project from the gene pool before it could reproduce.
The archaeological dig has been canceled before the civilization responsible could leave any further evidence.
The Smithsonian has withdrawn its interest in acquiring an incomplete artifact from the Age of Questionable Purchases.
The museum director has decided the empty display case is itself a superior exhibit.
The restaurant has canceled the special after the chef discovered the ingredients were more expensive than dinner.
Gordon Ramsay would approve of shutting down the kitchen before the printer starts inventing its own pasta dishes.
The cooking competition has been stopped before the contestants were asked to plate the supports.
The Michelin inspector has left before anyone could serve the complimentary side of polymer.
The grocery list can finally have the afternoon back.
The printer has clocked out before it could become eligible for an overtime rate.
The cancellation was the first engineering decision in this project that required neither a caliper nor a second opinion.
